fixture_gate: Reviewed diagnostic_postfreeze_v2 only; explicit manifest SHA supplied by root after errata review; v1 is rejected
source_scope: All 60 eligible sources per query, no topic/language/label prefilter; separate logical owner/namespace/activity/status/version controls are not vector authorization

bge_m3.weight_loading: AutoModel local_files_only=true trust_remote_code=false weights_only=true; use_safetensors=false for pinned official bin

e5_fp32.pooling: attention-mask mean including special tokens then L2

runtime.timing_scope: ordered diagnostic only; includes per-item tokenize/inference fields, excludes download; not balanced performance comparison

lexical.implementation: original Rust memory_lexical.rs via standalone adapter; no Python approximation
lexical.change: none; per-query fixture goal replaces old v2 diagnostic goal without changing lexical features or scoring

ranking.dense_score: dot product of FP32 normalized vectors accumulated in float64
ranking.tie_break: source ID ascending, independent of labels
ranking.selection: walk sorted candidates, skip a whole source if adding it exceeds budget, stop after 5 selected; never truncate sources

sufficient_sets: At least one complete minimal alternative set must be covered; never union alternatives into one impossible requirement

decision.pass_meaning: next opt-in candidate evaluation only, never source truth or default deployment

limits: Agent-authored, method-aware synthetic challenge, not blind human or real-world evaluation
Fixed v2 labels must be reviewed before all retrieval
No source kind, language, scope control labels or answer labels are embedding/scoring inputs
Scope checker is a logical fixture gate, not actual Store integration coverage
No similarity is calibrated confidence or proof of no evidence
No model downloads, packages or user database access from the inference probe
